statute_note: Principal source selected: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML edition (41-1978-urban-development-authority-act-consolidated.html, chain header 'Law Nos, 41 of 1978 Act Nos, 70 of 1979 4 of 1982 44 of 1984 49 of 1987 41 of 1988 Gazette Nos, 392-9-1986'), parsed into the accepted tree of 54 sections in 8 Parts, then finished by hand: section 26B split out of 26A (55 sections now), and Act No. 36 of 2007 applied from its own Government Printer text (paragraph (cc) in section 8; the Schedule already carried its item 4(e)). Other sources inspected: the registry's LankaLaw consolidated PDF (statutes/41-1978-urban-development-authority-act.pdf, 34 pp., text layer, chain header 'Law Nos, 41 of 1978 Act Nos, 70 of 1979 4 of 1982 44 of 1984 49 of 1987 41 of 1988 36 of 2007'), which is the latest consolidated edition held and was used for the Schedule (pp.30-32), the 26B heading (p.26) and the (cc) cross-check (p.7) rather than parsed whole: the HTML tree had already been reviewed and the PDF's only textual advance on it is the two operations of Act No. 36 of 2007, which are better traced to that Act's own text; the Government Printer PDF of Act No. 36 of 2007 (3 pp., text layer); scans of Acts Nos. 4 of 1982 (15 pp., with an OCR sidecar), 49 of 1987 (3 pp.) and 41 of 1988 (11 pp.), title pages read; and LankaLaw HTML of Acts Nos. 70 of 1979, 4 of 1982, 44 of 1984, 49 of 1987 and 41 of 1988 (none carries the subscription banner). Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 36 of 2007 (HTML baseline to Act No. 41 of 1988 plus the 2007 Act applied by hand). Review performed: diff of the accepted tree against the regenerated canonical parse (4 differences, two adopted: the 8L(1) Inland Revenue Act reference and a whitespace-only date); the 26A/26B, section 8 and Schedule regions read against the PDF text layer and the 4-of-1982 OCR; every held amending title page opened; validate_finalized_trees.py zero errors, zero undocumented warnings. Amendment coverage: 6 known, 6 held; five already in the HTML baseline (markers: 70 of 1979 x1, 4 of 1982 x23, 44 of 1984 x9 plus one misprinted '[ 9,4 of 1984]' on 28D, 49 of 1987 x1, 41 of 1988 x10), one (36 of 2007) applied from its own text. OCR and structural weaknesses: the section 8 heading carried the header's Gazette number twice (corrected, heading_raw kept); s.2 and s.4 subsections are printed out of order or mislabelled in the source and left as printed; s.28A/28B keep a nested (a)/(b) limb folded into the outer paragraph; 8G, 19A, 28C, 28D repeat their first child's text; s.19G's nine Code of Criminal Procedure references are only partly captured; the Schedule (from the PDF) skips item 15 and prints 16 twice, left as printed. The earlier package note saying the Schedule came from a single unchecked OCR source was stale: the tree's Schedule node records recovered_from 'consolidated_pdf_text_layer' (pp.30-32), which matches canonical-overrides SRC039.note (replaced 2026-08-26); the OCR-derived Schedule was superseded then. Missing sources: none of the six amending Acts is missing; no Government Printer copy of the principal Law itself is held (both editions are LankaLaw). Unresolved questions: the registry and curriculum call this an Act while section 1 and every amending Act call it a Law (tree title now 'Urban Development Authority Law', registry form under alternate_titles); the '392-9-1986' Gazette reference beside section 8 in both editions is not explained by either source. Lawyer verification: unverified.

The consolidated PDF header reads 'Law Nos, 41 of 1978 Act Nos, 70 of 1979 4 of 1982 44 of 1984 49 of 1987 41 of 1988 36 of 2007' and prints paragraph (cc) in section 8 (p.7) and the marker '[3,36 of 2007]' beside Schedule item 4(e) (p.31). Act No. 36 of 2007 was applied to the HTML baseline from its own Government Printer text, so the tree now reflects the same cutoff as the PDF.
